From: Susan Park <susan.park@helixhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + eval plan for HelixPilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at HelixHealth is excited to move toward a short pilot. We want to align on a Mutual Action Plan and a lightweight evaluation plan so we can validate latency, cost, and clinical-safety gating.

High level asks from our side:
- Can you share a MAP template we can co-edit (timeline + owners)?
- Rough week0 scope so our engineering and security teams can prep.
- Target timeline: pilot tech validation in June, pilot acceptance by end of July. Is that realistic?

Stakeholders to loop: me (product), our ML lead (Tobias), and procurement (procurement@helixhealth.com) — I’ll confirm exact names after this thread.

Can you send a first-pass MAP doc and a slide seed that we can take into our internal kickoff?

Thanks,
Susan
Susan Park
Head of Product, HelixHealth

Hi Susan — great to hear. Attaching a first-pass MAP template and a 6-slide week0 seed for the kickoff (links + attachment stubs below).

Quick summary of what I dropped into the MAP:
- Week0 (align + prep, owners): stakeholder roster (Susan), infra/keys (Helix infra), technical validation tasks (Redwood: Jonas), success criteria & acceptance matrix (Marissa).
- Week1–4: lightweight POC, sample payload testing, cost/perf profiling, security checklist.
- Acceptance gates: demo with Helix clinical reviewer, latency & p95 thresholds, spike resilience test, privacy info flow signoff.

Immediate asks for you to help accelerate this week:
1) Confirm the product & ML stakeholders (names + emails).
2) Share one representative dataset or sample payload schema (anonymized).
3) Confirm whether Helix requires a signed DPA/NDA before we run test data.

I also included a suggested schedule for the first demo (tentative: Friday, June 27) and a short owner matrix. If this looks good I’ll convert the doc to an editable GDoc and share co-edit access.

Links / attachments (stubs):
- MAP template (gdoc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-MAP-template
- Week0 slides (gslides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/placeholder-week0-slides
- Attachment: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (doc stub)
- Attachment: MAP-week0-slides.gslides (slides stub)

On process: we typically keep the MAP as the single source of truth and update it after each sync. We’ll add weekly cadences and a rolling risk register.

Next steps: I’ll wait for the stakeholder list and sample payload, then invite Helix reviewers to the doc. Propose a 30-minute kickoff next Tue or Wed (I’m flexible).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov

Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + eval plan for HelixPilot

Agree with Olga’s plan — a few technical items I added to the MAP under "Week0 technical validation":
- Provide 2–3 sample payloads (variation in token length) and a 1-hour traffic profile for perf modeling.
- Define p95 and tail-latency targets per endpoint (we recommend p95 < 250ms for core generation calls with 256-token context for this pilot).
- Decide on quantization profile (FP16 vs int8) early — affects cost and latency tradeoffs.
- Security validation: provide list of endpoints that need to be traffic-mirrored into your VPC or run via Redwood Dedicated.
- Add a small synthetic test harness (we can share a script) to reproduce a regression locally.

I’ll add owner tags (Jonas for runtime tests, Jasmine for integration examples). Can someone from Helix confirm whether clinical validation requires a separate environment or can run against anonymized staging data?

On the demo: June 27 works for us; propose 30–45 minutes with a live perf run + acceptance checklist walkthrough.

—Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + eval plan for HelixPilot

Thanks — I added a compact acceptance matrix to the MAP (attached stub) with pass/fail criteria and owner sign-offs. Highlights:
- Functional: example prompts -> expected canonical outputs + tolerances (Marissa owner).
- Performance: p95 latency and token-cost-per-1000 threshold (Jonas owner).
- Safety/Compliance: clinical content routing & audit log retention (Susan to confirm Helix policy).
- Rollout plan: canary -> 100% with automatic fallback to a smaller model if quality regresses.

Procurement note: Susan, when you have the right contact, please loop them in — we have a standard procurement packet and a short checklist for Dedicated vs Hosted options. Procurement often asks for estimated monthly token volumes for SOW/commit.

I attached: acceptance-matrix.xlsx (stub). I also put a slide that maps risks->mitigations into the week0 slides.

If Helix wants, we can lock the MAP into a weekly digest email that lists open owners and blockers every Monday. That tends to help momentum on pilots.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

June 27 demo is fine — we’ll plan for 45 minutes and bring Keisha for the compliance checkpoints. Please share GDoc co-edit access and I’ll have Tobias drop comments on the technical validation section.

Thanks — look forward to the kickoff.
Susan
